title: readme-readback / promote-latest review nits (LCLI-616 delta review): non-digit window exits 0, unpinned re-read command, unchecked skills-tree answers
description: Low-severity nits from the reviewer's delta pass over LCLI-616/618 (fc512e83..bc54206f, SHIP-WITH-NITS, 2026-09-27). Filed rather than fixed so LCLI-616/618 could land inside the session budget. Every one fails closed today. N1: under bash 3.2 a script file whose set -u trips inside $(( )) exits 0 (isolated in a 2-line script, no trap needed); REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS=abc makes readme-readback.sh print 'NOT-CONFIRMED the read-back stopped (exit 0)' and exit 0. promote still exits 3 because it classifies by the verdict line. Fix: reject a non-digit REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS up front. N2: the re-read command promote-latest prints on exit 3 (npm pack @opum-ai/lore@X && ... bash readme-readback.sh) carries no registry pins, so an operator whose ~/.npmrc sets an @opum-ai scope registry reads a mirror. Fix: prefix npm_config_userconfig=/dev/null and the two registry pins. N3: resolveSkillsTree does not check that commitDoc.sha === commit and treeDoc.sha === root (resolveTagCommit does, LCLI-613 N5), and reports 'has no skills/ tree entry' when the tree is truncated. Both give NOT RESOLVED, and the receiver re-resolves anyway. N4: a readme that appears only on the post-window packument read is NOT-CONFIRMED without being compared; it could be compared.

acceptanceCriteria.text: N1: a non-digit REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS is refused before the loop, with a non-zero exit and a NOT-CONFIRMED verdict line; a test drives it under /bin/bash 3.2
N2: the printed re-read command carries npm_config_userconfig=/dev/null and both registry pins; a test pins it
N3: resolveSkillsTree checks commit and tree object identity and names truncation; tests cover both
N4 decided: compare the late readme, or state why not, in the script comment
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; a reviewer pass covers the scripts change

plan: N1: validate REGISTRY_WINDOW_SECONDS as digits-only before the poll loop in readme-readback.sh; emit a NOT-CONFIRMED verdict and exit non-zero; test under /bin/bash 3.2
N2: build the exit-3 re-read command in promote-latest.mjs with npm_config_userconfig=/dev/null and both registry pins, from the constants the script's own npm calls use; pin it in a test
N3: resolveSkillsTree checks commitDoc.sha===commit and treeDoc.sha===root, and names truncation distinctly; tests for both
N4: compare a readme that first appears on the post-window read if small and fail-closed; otherwise state why not in a script comment
Gates: bun test, typecheck, lint, lint:shell, bun run lore check; win32-preload run of script-running tests; mutation proof for N1 and N3
implementationNotes: Landed on branch fix/LCLI-626-readback-nits at 6441a14c (not yet PR'd, not reviewed). N1: window validated as ^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,8})$ before any read; exit 2 + NOT-CONFIRMED verdict; test drives /bin/bash, asserted 3.2.57 on darwin; seven bad values, stub read count 0 each, plus a valid-window positive control. Mutant (guard -> if false): red, received exit 0 for 'abc' -- the reported defect reproduced; restored green. N2: new readbackRereadCommands(); npm words carry ANONYMOUS (--userconfig=devNull + both REGISTRY_PINS), script runs under env with readbackEnv's three vars from one shared READBACK_NPM_PINS table; unit test ties it to versionReadArgs and readbackEnv; exit-3 test asserts the printed lines. Residual: env cannot drop an operator's own uppercase NPM_CONFIG_* (F7), stated in the JSDoc. N3: commitDoc.sha===commit and treeDoc.sha===root checked; truncated===true is refused with its own message, listed entry or not. Mutant A (identity checks off): only the DIFFERENT-commit-or-tree test red (4 pass/1 fail); Mutant B (truncation check off): only the TRUNCATED test red, printing the old 'has no skills/ tree entry'; both restored green. N4: decided to COMPARE: late readme normalised as the in-window read is, byte-equal or assertions-hold = PASSED, else falls through to the prev-release lag check / FAILED; tests for all three outcomes. Gates: bun test 4259 pass 0 fail; typecheck, lint, lint:shell, bun run lore check all exit 0; win32 preload over both files 155 pass 22 skip 0 fail. lore 0.11.0 (source), quest 0.11.0, bun 1.3.14, shellcheck 0.11.0. AC5 (reviewer pass) left open.
